messages:
maya: quick handoff q before i sign off — can we do a 1-line checklist for what SRE vs runtime owns? handing off in 15m.

dan: sure. high level: SRE owns infra/networking/region failover, k8s node health, autoscaler config, and prov infra alerts. runtime owns model serving, model-variant fallbacks, kv-cache correctness, and per-model latency/regression alerts.

alex: adding: runtime also owns in-flight request graceful fallback (i.e., route to model-variant or degrade responses), batching behavior, and any model-specific quality alarms (prompt-set regressions).

lina: can we add paging thresholds? like when to page SRE vs runtime. makes handoffs much smoother.

dan: paging thresholds (draft):
- page SRE: cluster-wide CPU/GPU OOMs, node termination storms, region AZ outage, load balancer/networking anomalies, k8s control-plane down.
- page runtime: persistent per-model latency > SLO for 5m across 3 hosts, model OOMs, KV cache corruption, sudden spike in generation errors (500s)/deterministic hallucination alerts tied to evals.

maya: useful. what about "FYI vs incident" definition? i get pinged a lot for FYIs that maybe should be incidents.

alex: suggested rubric:
- Incident: customer-visible degradation (errors or elevated latency) affecting >1 customer or a paid tenant, or any security/data-exposure event. Requires incident channel, severity label (P0/P1), and postmortem if P0/P1.
- FYI: single-customer deg or non-customer-facing internal metric drift, planned maintenance notifications, capacity warnings that are not yet causing user impact.

dan: operationally, if you are unsure, escalate to oncall lead ("lina") and they decide to declare incident. we prefer short determination calls rather than slow back-and-forth.

lina: +1. also add quick actions to handoff note: link to runbooks, primary pager for SRE ("@sre-oncall") and runtime ("@runtime-oncall"), and a rollback plan if deploys are involved.

maya: can you paste the minimal handoff blurb i should drop into the shift note?

ops-bot: automated snippet:
```
Handoff (maya -> lina)
Time: 2026-03-17 17:45 UTC
Active issues: none
Known risks: canary rollout of model-x at 10% in us-west-2 (watch latency for model-x)
Who to page: @sre-oncall for infra/region issues, @runtime-oncall for model-serving/quality
Incident defn: page oncall lead if unsure; declare incident if multi-tenant customer impact or security
Runbooks: /docs/runbooks/infra, /docs/runbooks/runtime-model-failures
```

alex: tiny edits to snippet: include command to page quickly: `/page @runtime-oncall "model-x latency > SLO 5m"`

maya: perfect. i'll paste and sign off. thanks all. :thumbsup:

lina: thanks — i'll review the handoff note and follow up with any open watch items. if anything spikes after you leave, tag me and i'll triage.

dan: one more FYI: we updated autoscaler cooldowns to 90s in us-west-2 yesterday — should reduce flapping but it means reactive scale is a bit slower. include that in note as "scale cooldown change".

maya: adding to note now. good catch.

lina: done. have a good evening! :wave:
